name: Moai
author: fungiboletus
description: Moai by fungiboletus is modelled on the Minimoog Model D: fat basses, singing leads and brassy stabs, with 121 sounds to start from. Every voice has three oscillators and noise, a four-pole ladder filter with emphasis, drive and saturation, and a contour that sweeps the filter. Loudness comes from the OP-1's own envelope on T2, as on the other synths.
credits: fungiboletus's op-moai, brought into kennel by Hundekraft
